# InNetwork_Neuromorphic

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A computing paradigm where network infrastructure (e.g., switches, routers) is augmented with neuromorphic processing elements to perform in-transit computation. Bridges TCC and iNEST by enabling data to be processed during transmission, reducing latency and energy for spiking neural network workloads.
